d: A different room in the same house. Background In the middle of a black paper parade, behind which the acting persons emerge. Pao, a young prince, trembles the room. Tong in front of him; in many backward bends disappears into the scenery.
Garden and veranda in front of the house Mas. In the background the road passes by
Room in the house of Mr. Ma. table and chairs. Through a wide opening in the back wall one looks at garden and street. Mr. Ma sits at the table waiting for tea. Mrs. Ma sets the table

In the background, center, armchair of the main judge with table. Left and right armchair for siders. In the middle above the chair Gobelin with the image of the five-claw dragon. To the right and left beside it narrow flags with Chinese characters. In front of the chair of the judge a chalk circle is drawn into which the accused has to kneel. To the left and right in the foreground the room for witnesses and audience, separated from the middle room by barriers. Chu-chu, the judge, sits on the judge's chair and breakfasts
Snowstorm landscape. One hears a soldier singing behind the scene
